# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 58 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 5, Part 4 — How to Fast Properly

**58:1** "Lord," I said, "I also want to understand what fasting means in practice. How are we supposed to fast?" "Listen," he said. "Here is how you should fast on the designated fast days: eat nothing at all until the ninth hour. But then, after the ninth hour, eat the food you would otherwise have eaten that day. Whatever you have saved from your normal meals, give it to a widow, an orphan, or someone in need. By humbling yourself like this, the person who receives what you've given will be genuinely satisfied by your self-denial and will pray to the Lord on your behalf."

**58:2** "If you fast in this way — as I've just described — your sacrifice will be acceptable to God. This kind of fast will be counted and recorded. The service you render by doing this is beautiful, joyful, and truly pleasing to the Lord."

**58:3** "Observe these things with your children and everyone in your household. When you do, you will be blessed. And everyone who hears these words and puts them into practice will be blessed too — and whatever they ask from the Lord, they will receive."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the practical almsgiving-integrated fasting instruction of Hermas.*
